spots.name: CurrumbinAlley
spots.result:
DECISION: MARGINAL
QUALITY: 5/10
CONFIDENCE: HIGH

CONDITIONS
Wind: 10 knots, from 8° (NNE). This is a light cross-onshore wind for Currumbin Alley, expected to create some surface chop.
Swell: 1.16 m height, 6.25 s period, from 82° (ENE). This swell is moderate in size and comes from a direct onshore angle with a short period, likely resulting in less organised waves.
Wave height: 1.52 m total wave height. This indicates the overall ocean surface disturbance and not necessarily the breaking wave-face height.

ASSESSMENT
The moderate swell has sufficient height but its short period and direct onshore direction will likely produce less powerful and somewhat disorganised waves. Light cross-onshore wind will contribute to surface chop.

BOARD
A performance-oriented fish or hybrid board would suit to generate speed in potentially weaker, less powerful waves.

BEST WINDOW
A reliable time window cannot be determined from the available data.

BOTTOM LINE
Conditions are surfable for those keen to get in, but a quality-focused surfer might find them limiting.
